newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung Corning opens German glass bulb plant.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Corning opens German glass bulb plant.

text.p: Samsung Corning Co Ltd, a unit of South Korea's Samsung Group, said on Wednesday it had completed construction of a glass bulb plant in Germany with an annual capacity of eight million units.
The company said it invested 220 billion won to build the plant in Tschernitz, Brandenburg after taking over glass bulb maker Fernseh Glas Tschernitz in 1994.
Samsung said sales of its German plant were estimated at 95 billion won in 1997 and 130 billion won in 1998.
